# A lost accepted response is replayed with one request and one attempt sequence.
server start
retry-task task.json once 1
drop-response /skygo.v1.ControlService/SubmitRetryJob
! skygo --endpoint $PROXY --json run -f task.json --request-id retry-lost
stderr 'retry-lost'
! stdout .
skygo --json run -f task.json --request-id retry-lost --wait
job-id JOB
history failed succeeded
exists first second
skygo --json jobs get $JOB
history failed succeeded
calls SubmitJob 0
calls PlanTask 0
server stop
! stderr .
